# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for .github/workflows/thread-sanitizer.yml.
#
# Only uninstrumented third-party code belongs here, each entry with the report
# that justified it. xbbg's own code is never suppressed: a report in it is a
# bug to fix. The Python job appends CPython's own list for its exact
# interpreter release (Tools/tsan/suppressions_free_threading.txt), so known
# interpreter reports are not repeated here.
#
# Format: https://github.com/google/sanitizers/wiki/ThreadSanitizerSuppressions

# The Bloomberg C++ SDK is a prebuilt, uninstrumented library that links its
# C++ runtime statically, so TSan cannot see the synchronization inside it.
# When xbbg's test-support driver publishes from several threads at once, one
# thread's pthread_mutex_init and another's pthread_mutex_lock on the same SDK
# global (both called from inside libblpapi3_64.so) are reported as a race.
# This ignores only the libc calls the SDK makes itself: xbbg's accesses,
# including callbacks the SDK runs, are still checked.
called_from_lib:libblpapi3_64.so
